d.en: Maiden who offers to accompany the Tarnished. She grants Torrent, turns runes into levels and leads the way to the Erdtree.
d.pt: Donzela que se oferece para acompanhar o Maculado. Dá o Torrent, converte runas em níveis e guia o caminho até a Erdtree.

l.en: Appears at a Site of Grace in Limgrave (Gatefront and nearby) after a few rests; later at the Forge of the Giants.
l.pt: Aparece em uma Graça de Limgrave (Gatefront e arredores) depois de alguns descansos; mais tarde na Forge of the Giants.

d.en: Carian princess hiding as the witch Renna. Her plan against the Greater Will leads to the Age of the Stars ending.
d.pt: Princesa cariana escondida como a bruxa Renna. O plano dela contra a Greater Will leva ao final Age of the Stars.

l.en: Church of Elleh (Limgrave) at night after meeting Melina; later Ranni's Rise, Three Sisters (Liurnia of the Lakes).
l.pt: Church of Elleh (Limgrave) à noite, depois de conhecer Melina; depois Ranni's Rise, Three Sisters (Liurnia of the Lakes).

d.en: Ranni's loyal shadow, a half-wolf warrior. He helps against Darriwil and later guards Ranni's Rise.
d.pt: Sombra leal de Ranni, um guerreiro meio lobo. Ajuda contra Darriwil e depois guarda Ranni's Rise.

l.en: Mistwood Ruins and the Forlorn Hound Evergaol (Limgrave); Ranni's Rise (Liurnia).
l.pt: Mistwood Ruins e Forlorn Hound Evergaol (Limgrave); Ranni's Rise (Liurnia).

d.en: Giant smith who serves Ranni. He gives advice about her plan and reinforces weapons.
d.pt: Ferreiro gigante a serviço de Ranni. Dá conselhos sobre o plano dela e melhora armas.

l.en: Near the road to Caria Manor, north of the Liurnia lakes.
l.pt: Perto da estrada para Caria Manor, ao norte dos lagos de Liurnia.

d.en: Carian sorcerer who serves Ranni while running schemes of his own with potions and puppets.
d.pt: Feiticeiro cariano que serve Ranni enquanto faz planos próprios com poções e marionetes.

l.en: Seluvis's Rise, Three Sisters (Liurnia of the Lakes).
l.pt: Seluvis's Rise, Three Sisters (Liurnia of the Lakes).

d.en: Bloody Finger herald of Mohg. His quest opens the way to Mohgwyn Palace.
d.pt: Arauto dos Bloody Fingers a serviço de Mohg. A missão dele abre o caminho para Mohgwyn Palace.

l.en: The First Step (Limgrave), then Rose Church (Liurnia of the Lakes).
l.pt: The First Step (Limgrave), depois Rose Church (Liurnia of the Lakes).

d.en: The first merchant. Sells the Crafting Kit, the Telescope and basic supplies, and has a secret about the Mountaintops.
d.pt: O primeiro mercador. Vende o Crafting Kit, o Telescope e itens básicos, e guarda um segredo sobre as Mountaintops.

l.en: Church of Elleh (Limgrave).
l.pt: Church of Elleh (Limgrave).

d.en: Exiled sorceress who teaches glintstone sorceries and asks for help to regain her body.
d.pt: Feiticeira exilada que ensina feitiços de glintstone e pede ajuda para recuperar o próprio corpo.

l.en: Underground cell in the Waypoint Ruins (Limgrave); later the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
l.pt: Cela subterrânea nas Waypoint Ruins (Limgrave); depois a Academy of Raya Lucaria.

d.en: Grieving young woman who becomes the Spirit Tuner of Roundtable Hold.
d.pt: Jovem enlutada que se torna a afinadora de espíritos da Roundtable Hold.

l.en: Stormhill Shack (Stormhill), then Roundtable Hold.
l.pt: Stormhill Shack (Stormhill), depois Roundtable Hold.

d.en: Noble who wants Limgrave back in order. He asks for Fort Haight to be cleared and dreams of a new lord.
d.pt: Nobre que quer Limgrave em ordem. Pede para limpar o Fort Haight e sonha com um novo senhor.

l.en: Near the Third Church of Marika ruins on the Limgrave east road; later Stormveil Castle.
l.pt: Perto das ruínas a leste de Limgrave, no caminho do Fort Haight; depois Stormveil Castle.

d.en: Warrior of the Roundtable and Gideon's adopted daughter. Can become the lady of Stormveil.
d.pt: Guerreira da Roundtable e filha adotiva de Gideon. Pode se tornar a senhora de Stormveil.

l.en: Stormveil Castle, Roundtable Hold, Village of the Albinaurics.
l.pt: Stormveil Castle, Roundtable Hold, Village of the Albinaurics.

d.en: Gatekeeper of Stormveil Castle. Opens a side path, sells items and is not as harmless as he looks.
d.pt: Porteiro do Stormveil Castle. Abre um caminho lateral, vende itens e não é tão inofensivo quanto parece.

l.en: Gate of Stormveil Castle.
l.pt: Portão do Stormveil Castle.

d.en: Cheerful warrior jar seeking to become stronger. Shows up across the map until a final duel.
d.pt: Jarro guerreiro animado que quer ficar mais forte. Aparece pelo mapa até um duelo final.

l.en: Stuck in the ground north of Gatefront (Stormhill); then Liurnia, Caelid (Radahn festival), Mt. Gelmir, Jarburg and Crumbling Farum Azula.
l.pt: Preso no chão ao norte de Gatefront (Stormhill); depois Liurnia, Caelid (festival de Radahn), Mt. Gelmir, Jarburg e Crumbling Farum Azula.

d.en: Shameless merchant who lures the Tarnished into traps and swears it was nothing personal.
d.pt: Mercador sem vergonha que atrai o Maculado para armadilhas e jura que não foi nada pessoal.

l.en: Murkwater Cave (Limgrave), then Volcano Manor.
l.pt: Murkwater Cave (Limgrave), depois Volcano Manor.

d.en: Irina, a blind girl, asks to deliver a letter to her father Edgar, the castellan of Castle Morne.
d.pt: Irina, uma garota cega, pede para entregar uma carta ao pai Edgar, o castelão do Castle Morne.

l.en: Bridge of Sacrifice (Limgrave) and Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula); Edgar later at the Revenger's Shack (Liurnia).
l.pt: Bridge of Sacrifice (Limgrave) e Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula); Edgar depois no Revenger's Shack (Liurnia).

d.en: Demi-human seamster freed from a spell in the Coastal Cave. He alters armor at Sites of Grace.
d.pt: Costureiro meio-humano libertado de um feitiço na Coastal Cave. Ajusta armaduras nas Graças.

l.en: Coastal Cave and Stormhill; later Liurnia and the East Capital Rampart.
l.pt: Coastal Cave e Stormhill; depois Liurnia e o East Capital Rampart.

d.en: Blind maiden who asks for Shabriri Grapes. Her path leads to the Three Fingers and the Frenzied Flame.
d.pt: Donzela cega que pede Shabriri Grapes. O caminho dela leva aos Três Dedos e à Chama Frenética.

l.en: Lake-Facing Cliffs and later spots across Liurnia; finally the Frenzied Flame Proscription.
l.pt: Lake-Facing Cliffs e depois outros pontos de Liurnia; por fim a Frenzied Flame Proscription.

d.en: Priest who sells incantations of the Golden Order and follows Goldmask.
d.pt: Sacerdote que vende encantamentos da Ordem Dourada e segue Goldmask.

l.en: Roundtable Hold; later Altus Plateau and the Mountaintops of the Giants.
l.pt: Roundtable Hold; depois Altus Plateau e Mountaintops of the Giants.

d.en: Silent scholar of the Golden Order who seeks a perfect order without the gods.
d.pt: Estudioso silencioso da Ordem Dourada que busca uma ordem perfeita sem deuses.

l.en: Altus Plateau, near the bridge west of the Minor Erdtree; later Leyndell and the Mountaintops.
l.pt: Altus Plateau, perto da ponte a oeste da Minor Erdtree; depois Leyndell e as Mountaintops.

d.en: Embraces the Tarnished at Roundtable Hold. Her quest leads to the Age of the Duskborn.
d.pt: Abraça o Maculado na Roundtable Hold. A missão dela leva ao final Age of the Duskborn.

l.en: Roundtable Hold; later Deeproot Depths.
l.pt: Roundtable Hold; depois Deeproot Depths.

d.en: Hunter of those who live in death. His fate is tied to Fia's quest; his twin brother carries his armor on.
d.pt: Caçador dos que vivem na morte. O destino dele está ligado à missão de Fia; o irmão gêmeo herda a armadura.

l.en: Near the Summonwater Village area (Limgrave), then Roundtable Hold.
l.pt: Perto de Summonwater Village (Limgrave), depois Roundtable Hold.

d.en: Spellblade sorcerer who investigates the Black Knives and teaches sorceries.
d.pt: Feiticeiro espadachim que investiga as Black Knives e ensina feitiços.

l.en: Stormveil Castle, then Roundtable Hold.
l.pt: Stormveil Castle, depois Roundtable Hold.

d.en: A cursed murderer who defiles the dead. His quest leads to the Blessing of Despair ending.
d.pt: Assassino amaldiçoado que profana os mortos. A missão dele leva ao final Blessing of Despair.

l.en: Roundtable Hold; later the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds below Leyndell.
l.pt: Roundtable Hold; depois os Subterranean Shunning-Grounds abaixo de Leyndell.

x: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse

d.en: Leader of the Roundtable who collects knowledge about the demigods. He blocks the way in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
d.pt: Líder da Roundtable que coleciona saberes sobre os semideuses. Bloqueia o caminho em Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

l.en: Roundtable Hold; final fight in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
l.pt: Roundtable Hold; luta final em Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

d.en: Reads the Two Fingers' words and trades remembrances for weapons, spells and ashes.
d.pt: Lê as palavras dos Dois Dedos e troca lembranças por armas, feitiços e cinzas.

l.en: Roundtable Hold.
l.pt: Roundtable Hold.

d.en: Chained smith who reinforces weapons and swaps Ashes of War.
d.pt: Ferreiro acorrentado que melhora armas e troca Ashes of War.

l.en: Roundtable Hold.
l.pt: Roundtable Hold.

d.en: Young woman afflicted by Scarlet Rot who wants to find her purpose. Her journey ends in the Haligtree.
d.pt: Jovem afetada pela Scarlet Rot que quer descobrir seu propósito. A jornada dela termina na Haligtree.

l.en: Church of the Plague (Caelid); later Altus Plateau, Mt. Gelmir, Mountaintops and Elphael.
l.pt: Church of the Plague (Caelid); depois Altus Plateau, Mt. Gelmir, Mountaintops e Elphael.

d.en: Old sage who teaches sorceries and asks for help with Millicent. His intentions are not what they seem.
d.pt: Velho sábio que ensina feitiços e pede ajuda com Millicent. As intenções dele não são o que parecem.

l.en: Gowry's Shack (Caelid).
l.pt: Gowry's Shack (Caelid).

d.en: Sells Ashes of War and later appears at Volcano Manor. Faces the Tarnished in Crumbling Farum Azula.
d.pt: Vende Ashes of War e depois aparece na Volcano Manor. Enfrenta o Maculado em Crumbling Farum Azula.

l.en: Warmaster's Shack (Stormhill); Volcano Manor; Crumbling Farum Azula.
l.pt: Warmaster's Shack (Stormhill); Volcano Manor; Crumbling Farum Azula.

d.en: Tanith leads Volcano Manor in Rykard's name; Rya is the girl who invites the Tarnished there.
d.pt: Tanith comanda a Volcano Manor em nome de Rykard; Rya é a garota que convida o Maculado para lá.

l.en: Rya: Liurnia of the Lakes (Boilprawn Shack area); both at Volcano Manor.
l.pt: Rya: Liurnia of the Lakes (perto do Boilprawn Shack); as duas na Volcano Manor.

d.en: Old student who cannot get into the Academy without a key and teaches Thops's Barrier.
d.pt: Velho estudante que não consegue entrar na Academia sem uma chave e ensina Thops's Barrier.

l.en: Church of Irith (Liurnia of the Lakes), then Roundtable Hold.
l.pt: Church of Irith (Liurnia of the Lakes), depois Roundtable Hold.

d.en: Albinauric archer who asks to be taken to the Consecrated Snowfield to meet her sister.
d.pt: Arqueira albinaurica que pede para ser levada à Consecrated Snowfield para encontrar a irmã.

l.en: Slumbering Wolf's Shack (Liurnia of the Lakes).
l.pt: Slumbering Wolf's Shack (Liurnia of the Lakes).

d.en: Noble of the Hoslow house searching for Lady Lanya; ends up protecting Jarburg.
d.pt: Nobre da casa Hoslow que procura a Lady Lanya; acaba protegendo Jarburg.

l.en: Roundtable Hold, Volcano Manor and Jarburg (Liurnia).
l.pt: Roundtable Hold, Volcano Manor e Jarburg (Liurnia).

d.en: Beast priest who craves Deathroot and gives beast incantations and other rewards in exchange.
d.pt: Sacerdote fera que deseja Deathroot e dá encantamentos bestiais e outras recompensas em troca.

l.en: Bestial Sanctum (reached through the waygate in Limgrave's north, physically in Dragonbarrow).
l.pt: Bestial Sanctum (acessado por um portal no norte de Limgrave; fica em Dragonbarrow).

d.en: Hunter of Bloody Fingers who hates invaders. His story crosses Eleonora and Shabriri.
d.pt: Caçador de Bloody Fingers que odeia invasores. A história dele cruza com Eleonora e Shabriri.

l.en: Murkwater Coast (Limgrave); later Liurnia and Altus Plateau.
l.pt: Murkwater Coast (Limgrave); depois Liurnia e Altus Plateau.

d.en: Giant turtle priest who teaches spells from scrolls and prayerbooks the Tarnished brings.
d.pt: Tartaruga gigante sacerdote que ensina magias dos pergaminhos e livros de orações trazidos pelo Maculado.

l.en: Church of Vows (Liurnia of the Lakes).
l.pt: Church of Vows (Liurnia of the Lakes).

d.en: Leader of Miquella's followers in the Realm of Shadow. Asks for help finding the others who came after him.
d.pt: Líder dos seguidores de Miquella no Reino das Sombras. Pede ajuda para encontrar os outros que vieram atrás dele.

l.en: Near the start of the Gravesite Plain; later Highroad Cross and Enir-Ilim.
l.pt: Perto do início da Gravesite Plain; depois Highroad Cross e Enir-Ilim.

d.en: Old retainer of Mohg among Miquella's followers. Keeps his own counsel about Mohg's fate.
d.pt: Antigo servo de Mohg entre os seguidores de Miquella. Guarda as próprias opiniões sobre o destino de Mohg.

l.en: Gravesite Plain and Shadow Keep surroundings; later Enir-Ilim.
l.pt: Gravesite Plain e arredores do Shadow Keep; depois Enir-Ilim.

d.en: Melancholic follower devoted to St. Trina, always carrying sleep-inducing concoctions.
d.pt: Seguidor melancólico devoto de St. Trina, sempre com poções de sono.

l.en: Gravesite Plain (Pillar Path area) and Shadow Keep; later the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
l.pt: Gravesite Plain (região do Pillar Path) e Shadow Keep; depois Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

d.en: Redmane knight who followed Miquella. Carries a greatsword and her own doubts.
d.pt: Cavaleira da Redmane que seguiu Miquella. Carrega uma espada grande e as próprias dúvidas.

l.en: Gravesite Plain near Castle Ensis; later Scadu Altus and Enir-Ilim.
l.pt: Gravesite Plain perto do Castle Ensis; depois Scadu Altus e Enir-Ilim.

d.en: Gentle merchant among Miquella's followers who trades with the Tarnished.
d.pt: Mercador gentil entre os seguidores de Miquella que negocia com o Maculado.

l.en: Gravesite Plain (Prospect Town area); later Scadu Altus.
l.pt: Gravesite Plain (região de Prospect Town); depois Scadu Altus.

d.en: Hornsent warrior consumed by revenge against Messmer for the slaughter of his people.
d.pt: Guerreiro Hornsent consumido pela vingança contra Messmer pelo massacre do seu povo.

l.en: Gravesite Plain (near Belurat); later the Shadow Keep and the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
l.pt: Gravesite Plain (perto de Belurat); depois Shadow Keep e Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

d.en: Monk who fights with bare hands and Dryleaf Arts. Can be summoned against several bosses.
d.pt: Monge que luta com as mãos e com Dryleaf Arts. Pode ser invocado contra vários chefes.

l.en: Moorth Ruins (Scadu Altus) and summon signs near bosses.
l.pt: Moorth Ruins (Scadu Altus) e sinais de invocação perto de chefes.

d.en: Old dragon hunter who wants revenge on Bayle the Dread and fights at the Tarnished's side.
d.pt: Velho caçador de dragões que quer vingança contra Bayle the Dread e luta ao lado do Maculado.

l.en: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion (Foot of the Jagged Peak).
l.pt: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion (Foot of the Jagged Peak).

d.en: Priest of the Fingers who preaches about the Mother of Fingers and recruits Swordhands of Night.
d.pt: Sacerdote dos Dedos que prega sobre a Mother of Fingers e recruta as Swordhands of Night.

l.en: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus).
l.pt: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus).

d.en: The longest quest in the game: it crosses Liurnia, Nokron, the Ainsel River, the Lake of Rot and the Moonlight Altar and ends with the Age of the Stars.
d.pt: A missão mais longa do jogo: passa por Liurnia, Nokron, Ainsel River, Lake of Rot e Moonlight Altar e termina com o final Age of the Stars.

en: Meet Renna at the Church of Elleh at night and get the Spirit Calling Bell.
Reach Ranni's Rise (Three Sisters) by going through Caria Manor and Royal Moongazing Grounds; agree to serve her.
Defeat Starscourge Radahn so the stars move again, then enter Nokron, Eternal City.
Take the Fingerslayer Blade in Nokron and bring it to Ranni.
Find the Miniature Ranni and go through the Ainsel River and the Lake of Rot.
Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, and climb to the Moonlight Altar.
Take the Dark Moon Ring from the Cathedral of Manus Celes and put it on Ranni's finger.
pt: Encontre Renna na Church of Elleh à noite e receba o Spirit Calling Bell.
Chegue a Ranni's Rise (Three Sisters) passando por Caria Manor e Royal Moongazing Grounds; aceite servi-la.
Derrote Starscourge Radahn para as estrelas voltarem a se mover e entre em Nokron, Eternal City.
Pegue a Fingerslayer Blade em Nokron e leve para Ranni.
Encontre a Miniature Ranni e atravesse Ainsel River e Lake of Rot.
Derrote Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, e suba até o Moonlight Altar.
Pegue o Dark Moon Ring na Cathedral of Manus Celes e coloque no dedo de Ranni.

aviso.en: Do not attack Seluvis or Blaidd if you want every reward.
aviso.pt: Não ataque Seluvis nem Blaidd se quiser todas as recompensas.

d.en: Melina guides the Tarnished to the Erdtree. Her story closes at the Forge of the Giants.
d.pt: Melina guia o Maculado até a Erdtree. A história dela termina na Forge of the Giants.

en: Accept her offer at a Site of Grace in Limgrave.
Talk to her at graces along the way to Leyndell.
Reach the Forge of the Giants in the Mountaintops of the Giants and let her burn the Erdtree.
pt: Aceite a proposta dela em uma Graça de Limgrave.
Converse com ela nas Graças a caminho de Leyndell.
Chegue à Forge of the Giants nas Mountaintops of the Giants e deixe que ela queime a Erdtree.

d.en: Varre tests the Tarnished with invasions and opens the way to Mohgwyn Palace.
d.pt: Varre testa o Maculado com invasões e abre o caminho para Mohgwyn Palace.

en: Talk to him at The First Step, then at Rose Church in Liurnia.
Invade other players three times with the Festering Bloody Finger.
Soak the Lord of Blood's Favor in a maiden's blood (Church of Inhibition) and return to him.
Receive the Pureblood Knight's Medal, which takes you to Mohgwyn Palace.
pt: Fale com ele em The First Step e depois na Rose Church em Liurnia.
Invada outros jogadores três vezes com o Festering Bloody Finger.
Molhe o Lord of Blood's Favor com o sangue de uma donzela (Church of Inhibition) e volte até ele.
Receba o Pureblood Knight's Medal, que leva até Mohgwyn Palace.

d.en: Sellen asks for help to recover her real body at the Academy. At the end the Tarnished picks a side between her and Jerren.
d.pt: Sellen pede ajuda para recuperar o corpo verdadeiro na Academia. No fim o Maculado escolhe entre ela e Jerren.

en: Accept her as a teacher in the Waypoint Ruins.
Bring her a Primal Glintstone and follow her clues to the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
Find her real body at the Academy and meet Witch-Hunter Jerren.
Choose whom to help in the final fight.
pt: Aceite Sellen como professora nas Waypoint Ruins.
Leve uma Primal Glintstone e siga as pistas até a Academy of Raya Lucaria.
Encontre o corpo verdadeiro dela na Academia e encontre Witch-Hunter Jerren.
Escolha quem ajudar na luta final.

d.en: Two quests that join in Stormveil: Kenneth wants a lord for Limgrave and Nepheli may become it.
d.pt: Duas missões que se juntam em Stormveil: Kenneth quer um senhor para Limgrave e Nepheli pode assumir.

en: Clear Fort Haight for Kenneth Haight.
Defeat Godrick and talk to Nepheli at Roundtable Hold.
Help Nepheli with the requests tied to the Village of the Albinaurics.
Tell Kenneth about Nepheli; she ends up in Stormveil Castle's throne room.
pt: Limpe o Fort Haight para Kenneth Haight.
Derrote Godrick e fale com Nepheli na Roundtable Hold.
Ajude Nepheli nos pedidos ligados à Village of the Albinaurics.
Conte sobre Nepheli a Kenneth; ela termina na sala do trono do Stormveil Castle.

d.en: Help Alexander out of tight spots across the map until he challenges the Tarnished.
d.pt: Ajude Alexander em várias enrascadas pelo mapa até ele desafiar o Maculado.

en: Free him from the ground north of Gatefront.
Find him again in Liurnia and then at the Radahn festival in Caelid.
Help him at Mt. Gelmir's lava and visit Jarburg.
Duel him in Crumbling Farum Azula.
pt: Solte-o do chão ao norte de Gatefront.
Encontre-o de novo em Liurnia e depois no festival de Radahn em Caelid.
Ajude-o na lava do Mt. Gelmir e visite Jarburg.
Duele com ele em Crumbling Farum Azula.

d.en: Deliver Irina's letter to her father at Castle Morne and see how their story ends.
d.pt: Entregue a carta de Irina ao pai no Castle Morne e veja como termina a história deles.

en: Take the letter from Irina on the Bridge of Sacrifice.
Deliver it to Edgar at Castle Morne and clear the castle.
Find Edgar again in Liurnia (Revenger's Shack area).
pt: Pegue a carta com Irina na Bridge of Sacrifice.
Entregue a Edgar no Castle Morne e limpe o castelo.
Encontre Edgar de novo em Liurnia (perto do Revenger's Shack).

d.en: Bring Roderika to Roundtable Hold so she can become the Spirit Tuner.
d.pt: Leve Roderika à Roundtable Hold para ela virar a afinadora de espíritos.

en: Talk to her at Stormhill Shack.
Get through Stormveil Castle and tell her about Roundtable Hold.
At Roundtable Hold, convince Hewg to work with her.
pt: Converse com ela no Stormhill Shack.
Passe pelo Stormveil Castle e conte a ela sobre a Roundtable Hold.
Na Roundtable Hold, convença Hewg a trabalhar com ela.

d.en: Free Boc in the Coastal Cave so he can alter armor.
d.pt: Liberte Boc na Coastal Cave para ele ajustar armaduras.

en: Defeat the demi-human chiefs in the Coastal Cave.
Meet him again in Stormhill and later around Liurnia.
Give him a Gold Sewing Needle when he asks for one.
pt: Derrote os chefes meio-humanos na Coastal Cave.
Encontre-o de novo em Stormhill e depois em Liurnia.
Entregue uma Gold Sewing Needle quando ele pedir.

d.en: Hyetta asks for Shabriri Grapes. Her path leads to the Three Fingers and the Frenzied Flame ending.
d.pt: Hyetta pede Shabriri Grapes. O caminho dela leva aos Três Dedos e ao final da Chama Frenética.

en: Give her grapes at each of her stops across Liurnia.
Follow her to the Frenzied Flame Proscription below Leyndell.
Decide whether to accept the Frenzied Flame from the Three Fingers.
pt: Entregue uvas em cada parada dela por Liurnia.
Siga-a até a Frenzied Flame Proscription abaixo de Leyndell.
Decida se aceita a Chama Frenética dos Três Dedos.

aviso.en: Accepting the flame locks the other endings until it is removed with Miquella's Needle.
aviso.pt: Aceitar a chama bloqueia os outros finais até ela ser removida com a Miquella's Needle.

d.en: Help Goldmask unravel the Golden Order. Rewards the Mending Rune of Perfect Order.
d.pt: Ajude Goldmask a desvendar a Ordem Dourada. Rende a Mending Rune of Perfect Order.

en: Talk to Brother Corhyn after reaching the Altus Plateau.
Find Goldmask on the Altus Plateau.
Solve the Law of Regression riddle in Leyndell and report it.
Meet them in the Mountaintops and get the rune at the end of the quest.
pt: Converse com Brother Corhyn depois de chegar ao Altus Plateau.
Encontre Goldmask no Altus Plateau.
Resolva o enigma da Law of Regression em Leyndell e conte a eles.
Encontre os dois nas Mountaintops e pegue a runa no fim da missão.

d.en: Fia's plan to bring Destined Death back passes through D and Rogier and ends in Deeproot Depths.
d.pt: O plano de Fia de trazer de volta a Morte Destinada passa por D e Rogier e termina em Deeproot Depths.

en: Accept Fia's embrace at Roundtable Hold.
Follow her requests while D and Rogier are still in the Hold.
Find her in Deeproot Depths and defeat Lichdragon Fortissax.
Take the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince.
pt: Aceite o abraço de Fia na Roundtable Hold.
Siga os pedidos dela enquanto D e Rogier ainda estão no lugar.
Encontre-a em Deeproot Depths e derrote Lichdragon Fortissax.
Pegue a Mending Rune of the Death-Prince.

d.en: Rogier investigates the Black Knife Assassins. His quest gives the Black Knifeprint and spells.
d.pt: Rogier investiga as Black Knife Assassins. A missão dele dá a Black Knifeprint e magias.

en: Meet him in Stormveil Castle and again at Roundtable Hold.
Find the Black Knifeprint in Liurnia (Black Knife Catacombs).
Tell him about it and about Ranni.
pt: Encontre-o no Stormveil Castle e de novo na Roundtable Hold.
Ache a Black Knifeprint em Liurnia (Black Knife Catacombs).
Conte a ele sobre ela e sobre Ranni.

d.en: Free the Dung Eater in the sewers and give him Seedbed Curses.
d.pt: Liberte o Dung Eater nos esgotos e entregue Seedbed Curses.

en: Hear him out at Roundtable Hold.
Find his cell in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Sewer-Gaol Key).
Bring him five Seedbed Curses.
Take the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.
pt: Escute-o na Roundtable Hold.
Ache a cela dele nos Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Sewer-Gaol Key).
Leve cinco Seedbed Curses.
Pegue a Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.

x: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse

d.en: Cure Millicent and help her on a journey that ends in Elphael.
d.pt: Cure Millicent e ajude-a numa jornada que termina em Elphael.

en: Defeat Commander O'Neil in the Swamp of Aeonia and take the Unalloyed Gold Needle to Gowry.
Bring the fixed needle to Millicent.
Meet her in Altus Plateau, Mt. Gelmir and the Mountaintops.
Decide to help or betray her in Elphael.
pt: Derrote Commander O'Neil na Swamp of Aeonia e leve a Unalloyed Gold Needle a Gowry.
Leve a agulha consertada a Millicent.
Encontre-a no Altus Plateau, no Mt. Gelmir e nas Mountaintops.
Decida ajudá-la ou traí-la em Elphael.

d.en: Tanith gives assassination contracts against other Tarnished. The thread ends with Rykard.
d.pt: Tanith dá contratos de assassinato contra outros Maculados. O enredo termina com Rykard.

en: Accept Rya's invitation (or reach the manor) and talk to Tanith.
Complete the manor's contracts across the map.
Defeat Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.
pt: Aceite o convite de Rya (ou chegue à mansão) e fale com Tanith.
Cumpra os contratos da mansão pelo mapa.
Derrote Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

d.en: Give Thops an Academy Glintstone Key so he can return to his studies.
d.pt: Dê a Thops uma Academy Glintstone Key para ele voltar aos estudos.

en: Meet him at the Church of Irith.
Give him a spare Academy Glintstone Key.
Look for him later inside the Academy.
pt: Encontre-o na Church of Irith.
Dê a ele uma Academy Glintstone Key extra.
Procure-o depois dentro da Academia.

d.en: Take Latenna's spirit to the Consecrated Snowfield. Gives the other half of the Haligtree medallion.
d.pt: Leve o espírito de Latenna à Consecrated Snowfield. Dá a outra metade do medalhão da Haligtree.

en: Get the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) from Albus in the Village of the Albinaurics.
Show it to Latenna to receive her spirit ash.
Take her to the Apostate Derelict in the Consecrated Snowfield.
pt: Pegue o Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) com Albus na Village of the Albinaurics.
Mostre a Latenna para receber o espírito dela.
Leve-a até o Apostate Derelict na Consecrated Snowfield.

d.en: Diallos searches for Lanya and ends up defending Jarburg.
d.pt: Diallos procura Lanya e acaba defendendo Jarburg.

en: Talk to him at Roundtable Hold.
Meet him at Volcano Manor.
Find him in Jarburg.
pt: Fale com ele na Roundtable Hold.
Encontre-o na Volcano Manor.
Ache-o em Jarburg.

d.en: Patches keeps crossing paths with the Tarnished, from Murkwater Cave to Volcano Manor.
d.pt: Patches cruza o caminho do Maculado da Murkwater Cave até a Volcano Manor.

en: Spare him in Murkwater Cave.
Find him again in Liurnia (Grand Lift of Dectus area).
Meet him at Volcano Manor.
pt: Poupe-o na Murkwater Cave.
Encontre-o de novo em Liurnia (perto do Grand Lift of Dectus).
Encontre-o na Volcano Manor.

d.en: Yura hunts Bloody Fingers; his quest reveals what Shabriri is.
d.pt: Yura caça Bloody Fingers; a missão dele revela o que é Shabriri.

en: Meet him on the Murkwater Coast.
Help him against Eleonora in Liurnia (Second Church of Marika area).
Find him again on the Altus Plateau.
pt: Encontre-o na Murkwater Coast.
Ajude-o contra Eleonora (perto da Second Church of Marika).
Encontre-o de novo no Altus Plateau.

d.en: Leda gathers Miquella's followers. Her path ends in a fight among them in Enir-Ilim.
d.pt: Leda reúne os seguidores de Miquella. O caminho dela termina numa luta entre eles em Enir-Ilim.

en: Talk to Leda near the start of the Realm of Shadow.
Find the other followers (Freyja, Ansbach, Thiollier, Hornsent, Moore, Dane).
Report back to Leda at Highroad Cross.
Choose sides when the followers turn on each other in Enir-Ilim.
pt: Fale com Leda perto do início do Reino das Sombras.
Encontre os outros seguidores (Freyja, Ansbach, Thiollier, Hornsent, Moore, Dane).
Volte a Leda em Highroad Cross.
Escolha um lado quando os seguidores se voltarem uns contra os outros em Enir-Ilim.

d.en: Ansbach looks for answers about Mohg and Messmer. Helps in the final clash with Leda.
d.pt: Ansbach busca respostas sobre Mohg e Messmer. Ajuda no confronto final com Leda.

en: Meet him in the Gravesite Plain.
Talk to him after events in the Shadow Keep.
Answer his questions honestly and meet him in Enir-Ilim.
pt: Encontre-o na Gravesite Plain.
Fale com ele depois dos eventos do Shadow Keep.
Responda as perguntas dele e encontre-o em Enir-Ilim.

d.en: Thiollier follows St. Trina and brews sleeping concoctions.
d.pt: Thiollier segue St. Trina e prepara poções de sono.

en: Meet him near the Pillar Path.
Find him again at the Shadow Keep.
Follow him to the Ancient Ruins of Rauh and the Church of the Bud area.
pt: Encontre-o perto do Pillar Path.
Ache-o de novo no Shadow Keep.
Siga-o até as Ancient Ruins of Rauh e a região da Church of the Bud.

d.en: Hornsent wants revenge for his people. Gives a choice about the Hornsent Grandam.
d.pt: Hornsent quer vingança pelo seu povo. Dá uma escolha sobre a Hornsent Grandam.

en: Meet him near Belurat.
Report what you learn in the Shadow Keep.
Decide whether to help with his revenge.
pt: Encontre-o perto de Belurat.
Conte o que descobriu no Shadow Keep.
Decida se ajuda na vingança dele.

d.en: Moore trades with the Tarnished and later has a request about the Divine Beast and the Hornsent.
d.pt: Moore negocia com o Maculado e depois tem um pedido envolvendo a Divine Beast e os Hornsent.

en: Meet him in the Gravesite Plain.
Help him with his requests in Scadu Altus.
Find him again later on.
pt: Encontre-o na Gravesite Plain.
Ajude-o nos pedidos em Scadu Altus.
Encontre-o de novo mais adiante.

d.en: Dane can be summoned in boss fights and teaches the way of the fist.
d.pt: Dane pode ser invocado em lutas de chefes e ensina o caminho dos punhos.

en: Meet him at the Moorth Ruins.
Summon him at the boss fogs where his sign appears.
Face him at the end of his story.
pt: Encontre-o nas Moorth Ruins.
Invoque-o nas névoas de chefes onde aparece o sinal dele.
Enfrente-o no fim da história dele.

d.en: Igon hunts Bayle the Dread. Summon him for the fight to complete his story.
d.pt: Igon caça Bayle the Dread. Invoque-o na luta para concluir a história dele.

en: Meet him at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.
Climb the Jagged Peak.
Summon Igon against Bayle the Dread.
pt: Encontre-o no Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.
Suba o Jagged Peak.
Invoque Igon contra Bayle the Dread.

d.en: Ymir sends the Tarnished to deal with Swordhands of Night and leads to the Mother of Fingers.
d.pt: Ymir manda o Maculado lidar com as Swordhands of Night e leva à Mother of Fingers.

en: Talk to Ymir in the cathedral.
Hunt the Swordhands of Night he points out.
Reach the Finger Ruins of Miyr and face Metyr, Mother of Fingers.
pt: Converse com Ymir na catedral.
Cace as Swordhands of Night indicadas por ele.
Chegue às Finger Ruins of Miyr e enfrente Metyr, Mother of Fingers.
